Job Description – HR Generalist
• Participates and administers the development and implementation of
recruitment strategies and staffing levels, applicant evaluation, interview
and selection process, and related tasks.
• Conducts interviews to determine the knowledge, skills and abilities of
candidate.
• Conducts new hire orientation to all newly hired employees.
• Provides assistance, facilitation and guidance in conducting counselling
sessions for employees who have demonstrated behaviours not aligned
with the company’s corporate values.
• Collaborates with the managers and supervisors to ensure that decisions
and actions in implementing action steps for progressive discipline are
aligned with local compliance regulations.
• Assists in conducting annual performance evaluation review and ensures
retrieval of all documented performance reviews on time. Consolidates
and summarizes the company-wide performance review results.
• Assist in conducting pay and job evaluations by participating in surveys
to provide recommendations in order to implement new pay structures.
• Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable
human resource federal and state requirements; conducting
investigations; maintaining records; representing the organization at
hearings.
• Maintains management guidelines by preparing, updating, and
recommending human resource policies and procedures.
• Performs other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

## Job Title: AI Operations Coordinator
**Location:** [Remote/Hybrid/City]
**Reports to:** [CTO / Operations Manager / Head of Automation]
### Role Overview
The **AI Operations Coordinator** is responsible for the orchestration, implementation, and
maintenance of AI-driven workflows. You won’t just be "prompting"—you will be building the
nervous system of our company. You will identify manual bottlenecks and solve them by
connecting our core tools (CRM, Email, Slack) to AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) using
automation platforms like **n8n**.
---
### Key Responsibilities
* **Workflow Orchestration:** Design, build, and maintain complex automation workflows in
**n8n** or similar tools.
* **Prompt Engineering:** Develop and refine system prompts to ensure AI outputs are
accurate, on-brand, and formatted correctly (JSON, Markdown, etc.).
* **Tool Integration:** Connect disparate APIs to AI models, ensuring seamless data flow and
high "MIME type" integrity across documents and data streams.
* **Quality Assurance:** Monitor AI "hallucinations" and workflow failures, implementing
error-handling paths (e.g., "Wait for Approval" nodes) to ensure human-in-the-loop oversight.
* **AI Training:** Stay at the forefront of the "AI-as-a-Service" landscape, testing new models
and features to keep our tech stack modern.
---
### Technical Requirements
* **Automation Mastery:** Pro level with **n8n**, Zapier, or Make.com.
* **Data Handling:** Comfortable with JSON structures, REST APIs, and Webhooks.
* **Basic Scripting:** Ability to write or tweak **JavaScript** or **Python** snippets within
automation nodes.
* **Document Logic:** Understanding of file types and MIME types (e.g., handling `.docx` via
`application/vnd.openxml...`) for document processing.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Ability to map out a manual business process into a logical flow chart.
---
### Soft Skills
* **The "Translator":** You can explain technical AI limitations to non-technical staff.
* **Problem Solver:** You don't just see a bug; you see a missing logic gate.
* **Adaptability:** The AI world changes weekly; you must enjoy the "always learning" grind.

---
### Why This Role Matters
In this position, you aren't just an admin; you are an **Efficiency Architect**. You are responsible
for turning 10 hours of manual data entry into 10 seconds of automated intelligence.

1. Copier Service Technician (Entry to Mid-Level)
Focus: Maintenance, troubleshooting, and customer service.
Role Overview
We are looking for a reliable Copier Service Technician to join our field operations team. You
will be the face of the company, traveling to client sites to install, repair, and maintain
multifunction printers (MFPs) and digital imaging hardware. If you enjoy solving mechanical
puzzles and helping people get back to work, this is for you.
Key Responsibilities
● On-Site Diagnostics: Identify and resolve mechanical, electrical, and network
connectivity issues for office equipment.
● Preventative Maintenance: Perform routine cleaning and parts replacement to ensure
long-term machine reliability.
● Software Integration: Install print drivers and scan-to-email/folder configurations on
client networks.
● Inventory Management: Track parts usage and maintain a clean, organized service
vehicle.
Qualifications
● Strong mechanical aptitude (experience with gears, rollers, and sensors).
● Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking and Windows/Mac OS.
● Excellent communication skills—you can explain a technical fix to a non-technical office
manager.
● Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.

Marketing Lead
Focus: Brand strategy, lead generation, and digital presence.
Role Overview
We are seeking a high-energy Marketing Lead to bridge the gap between our services and our
future clients. You will be responsible for defining our brand voice, managing our digital footprint,
and creating campaigns that convert "just looking" into "request a quote."
Key Responsibilities
● Campaign Strategy: Design and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns (Email,
LinkedIn, SEO/SEM) to drive B2B leads.
● Content Creation: Manage the production of case studies, blog posts, and social media
content that highlights our technical expertise.
● Market Analysis: Keep a pulse on industry trends and competitor pricing to keep our
offerings sharp.
● Sales Alignment: Work closely with the sales team to provide high-quality sales
enablement materials and track ROI on marketing spend.
Qualifications
● Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
● Proven track record of managing social media accounts and Google Ads/Analytics.
● A "growth mindset"—you aren't afraid to test new ideas, fail fast, and pivot.
● Experience in a B2B or service-based industry is a major plus.
